name: Push-up
description: A classic bodyweight exercise that works the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
tips: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.

name: Squat
description: A fundamental lower body exercise that targets the quads, hamstrings, and glutes.
tips: Descend as if sitting back into a chair.

name: Plank
description: An isometric core exercise that strengthens the entire core musculature.
tips: Keep your body in a straight line, engaging your abs.

name: Lunges
description: A unilateral leg exercise that improves balance and strengthens the quads, hamstrings, and glutes.
tips: Ensure your front knee doesn't go past your toes.

name: Deadlift
description: A full-body compound exercise that builds strength in the back, glutes, and hamstrings.
tips: Maintain a flat back throughout the lift.

name: Overhead Press
description: A strength exercise that targets the shoulders and triceps.
tips: Keep your core tight to stabilize your body.

name: Bench Press
description: A compound exercise for the chest, shoulders, and triceps.
tips: Keep your feet flat on the floor and arch your lower back slightly.

name: Pull-up
description: A challenging bodyweight exercise that works the back and biceps.
tips: Engage your lats to pull yourself up.

name: Rows (Dumbbell or Barbell)
description: Exercises that target the back muscles, improving posture and strength.
tips: Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.

name: Burpees
description: A full-body calisthenics exercise that combines a squat, push-up, and jump.
tips: Focus on fluid movement between each step.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: A dynamic core exercise that also provides a cardiovascular workout.
tips: Keep your core engaged and avoid letting your hips sag.

name: Bicep Curls
description: An isolation exercise for building bicep strength and size.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked in and avoid swinging the weights.

name: Tricep Extensions (Overhead)
description: An isolation exercise for targeting the triceps.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary.

name: Calf Raises
description: An exercise to strengthen the calf muscles.
tips: Go through a full range of motion, pausing at the top.

name: Leg Press
description: A machine-based exercise for building lower body strength.
tips: Ensure your lower back stays pressed against the pad.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: A machine-based exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi (lats) muscles.
tips: Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.

name: Russian Twists
description: A core exercise that works the obliques and rectus abdominis.
tips: Keep your back straight and twist from your torso.

name: Box Jumps
description: A plyometric exercise that improves explosive power in the legs.
tips: Land softly with bent knees to absorb the impact.

name: Kettlebell Swings
description: A dynamic exercise that targets the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back.
tips: Hinge at your hips, using your glutes to drive the kettlebell up.

name: Bird Dog
description: A core stability exercise that strengthens the back and improves balance.
tips: Keep your core engaged and your back flat, moving slowly and controlled.
